item.title: Dr. Celina Montemayor-Garcia
item.description: Dr. Celina Montemayor-Garcia has joined Carter BloodCare as Chief Medical Officer. She previously served as Medical and Scientific Lead, Red Cell Genomics, with Canadian Blood Services, and was Transfusion Medicine Physician at Unity Health Toronto.
